get_src_data: get source data sources from a directory matching src_*.* pattern
get_ref_data: get reference data sources from a directory matching ref_*.txt pattern
get_tag_data: get tag data sources from a directory matching tag_*.txt pattern with merged text
get_hypo_data: get hypothesis prediction data sources from a directory matching pred_*.txt pattern
get_scores: get scoring results for a metric by combining hypothesis, reference, and tag data
